subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw officially own Qwen Token Plan support in the bundled qwen plugin, including qwen-token-plan setup/auth/catalog plus legacy bailian-token-plan compatibility handling?
rationale: The code path is technically coherent, but adding an official provider id, env/auth surface, outbound endpoint hosts, and vendor model catalog is a product ownership decision rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept bundled Token Plan support
options.body: Land the PR after maintainer review, treating qwen-token-plan and the legacy bailian-token-plan compatibility path as official OpenClaw provider contracts.

options.title: Require a narrower external plugin
options.body: Close or redirect this PR if maintainers want Token Plan support to live outside core/bundled qwen ownership until broader provider policy is settled.

options.title: Pause for vendor/catalog confirmation
options.body: Hold merge until maintainers independently verify the Token Plan model list, endpoint regions, and zero-cost metadata against current Alibaba contracts.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled Token Plan support
recommendation.body: Land the PR after maintainer review, treating qwen-token-plan and the legacy bailian-token-plan compatibility path as official OpenClaw provider contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current provider/catalog repair commits and is assigned on the live PR, so he is best positioned to decide whether OpenClaw should own this official provider surface.
